items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: I just remember my mother used to tell me this was her husband. His name was Giles. Giles Moore.

ctx.x: I see. Did you know your father's people, his mother and father?
No, I didn't know none of those. All I know is... I just remember my mother used to tell me this was her husband. His name was Giles. Giles Moore.
